title: b7z9.29.2: Python+Rust: implement peer-counting density estimator
description: Spec R-02a-117: MUST estimate density from distinct link-layer peers heard in the current metrics window. Rust rf_health.rs:122-137 estimate_density() is a formula taking neighbor_count as input but no peer-counting accumulator exists. Python has no density estimator. Implement: rolling-window peer tracker (set of distinct L2 source addresses heard in last RF_METRICS_WINDOW_SF=32 superframes), report count changes to L2. Test with ccp16_load_balance.json estimate_density vectors (lines 623-734).
